name: il.co.esek-shave/valuation
title: Israel Small Business Valuation (esek-shave)
description: Value an Israeli small business: likely price in ILS, low-high range and confidence. Free.

tools.name: estimate_business_value
tools.description: Estimates the market value in ILS of a specific small or mid-sized business in Israel, from its industry, annual revenue and annual pre-tax profit. Use this when someone asks what an Israeli business is worth or what price is fair for it: an owner selling or setting an asking price, a partner leaving or being bought out, a buyer checking whether an asking price makes sense, an accountant or broker preparing a number for a client, a bank or investor asking, or a divorce or inheritance that includes a business. Typical requests: "כמה שווה העסק שלי", "כמה לבקש על המסעדה", "הערכת שווי לעסק", "השותף רוצה לצאת, כמה לשלם לו", "מבקשים 800 אלף על בית הקפה, זה הוגן?", "what is my cafe in Tel Aviv worth". Covers restaurants and cafes, retail, professional services, clinics, beauty and barbershops, construction trades, education, logistics, events and tech services. Not for public companies, real estate, startups priced on a funding round, or businesses outside Israel. A profit range (annualProfitMin/annualProfitMax) works when exact profit is unknown. Returns the likely value, a low-high range, a confidence level, a Hebrew summary, the follow-up questions that would tighten the number, and a link to the full calculation on esek-shave.co.il. Method: Israeli industry multiples on owner profit (SDE), cross-checked with a revenue multiple, adjusted for owner salary, years in business and debt.

industry.description: Industry, Hebrew name (e.g. מזון ומסעדנות) or English alias (restaurant, retail, clinic, dentist, services, accounting, tech, construction, plumber, beauty, salon, education, logistics, events, other). Send "other" if nothing fits.

annualProfit.description: Annual pre-tax profit in ILS. Negative for a loss. If the owner only knows a rough range, send the midpoint here and the bounds in annualProfitMin / annualProfitMax.

annualProfitMin.description: Optional. Lower bound of annual profit when the owner only knows a range (e.g. 100000 for "100-200 thousand").

annualProfitMax.description: Optional. Upper bound of annual profit when the owner only knows a range.

annualRevenue.description: Annual revenue (turnover) in ILS, e.g. 2400000. If the owner gives a monthly figure, multiply by 12.

ownerSalary.description: Annual salary the business pays the owner as an expense (company / בע"מ only), in ILS. It is added back to profit. For a sole proprietor (עוסק) the profit already includes the owner's earnings: send 0 or omit.

yearsActive.description: Optional. Years the business has been operating. If unknown, omit it: the estimate treats age as neutral and lists it as a follow-up question.

loansBalance.description: Outstanding loans and supplier debt in ILS (optional, deducted). 0 = no debt.

tools.name: get_industry_multiples
tools.description: Returns the typical valuation multiples for small businesses in Israel by industry: the SDE (owner profit) multiple range and the revenue multiple range. Use this for general questions about how businesses in an Israeli industry are priced, with no specific business figures, such as "at what multiple do restaurants sell in Israel", "מה המכפיל של מסעדה", "כמה שנות רווח משלמים על עסק", or to explain where a valuation came from. For the value of one specific business, estimate_business_value takes its revenue and profit.

industry.description: Optional. Hebrew industry name or English alias (restaurant, retail, clinic, services, tech, construction, beauty, education, logistics, events). Omit to get all industries.
